label: sd-turbo-512-1step/text

provenance.summary: OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 text encoder as shipped in stabilityai/sd-turbo: 23 layers, hidden 1024, 16 heads, GELU, 77 tokens. int32 token ids in, [1,77,1024] float16 embedding out.

folds.name: linear-as-matmul
folds.what: Every linear layer is a matmul against a pre-transposed weight, not a 1x1 conv2d.
folds.why: fewer ops; on a backend that fuses almost nothing, op count on this small graph is real time

folds.name: embedding-as-gather
folds.what: The token embedding is one gather over a [49408,1024] float16 constant (101 MB).

folds.name: packed-qkv
folds.what: to_q/to_k/to_v are one packed matmul followed by split(3).

folds.name: nchw
folds.what: This graph has no spatial ops, so `layout` is nominally nchw and carries no meaning.

rewritesRejected.name: run on the Neural Engine (separate npu context)
rewritesRejected.number: 7.4 ms either way; embedding max abs 3.125e-2 -> 6.250e-2, 2.7x the float16 floor
rewritesRejected.reason: 601/608 ops are ANE-eligible and it does compile for the ANE (build 4.8 s -> 42.6 s), but dispatch is unchanged, so there is no speed to trade for the accuracy loss

provenance.verification: max abs 1.99e-2 vs the fp32 CPU reference; the float16-on-MPS noise floor is 2.3e-2 (0.87x)

note: ops[] is the exact MLGraphBuilder call sequence. Operand names share one namespace (graph inputs keep their own names, constants k<N>, op results v<N>). Multi-output ops (split) carry `outputs`/`outputShapes` arrays as well as `output`/`outputShape`; every name in `outputs` is defined by that op.
